caption: Figure 9.1: System Call sequence chart The above sequence describes a call to the CallTrustedFunction service. It starts with a user who calls a service which requires itself a call to a trusted function. The service then packs the argument for the trusted function into a structure and calls CallTrustedFunction with the ID and the pointer as arguments. Afterwards the OS checks if the access to the requested service is valid. If no access is granted E_OS_SERVICEID is returned. Otherwise the trusted service itself is called and the function checks the arguments for access right, etc.
